turns.mechanic: EXEED hybrid with three current codes: P1A7309 in the HCU, P301A4B and P302A01 in the MCUF.
One motor temperature sensor circuit reads about 15 kohm. The other reads 0 ohm with the inverter main connector plugged in.
Unplugged the inverter main connector and the second circuit went back to about 15 kohm. Replaced the inverter and the car runs normally.
